concept: Codex provider capabilities struct and where namespace serialization is gated
summary: Which commit removed `namespace_tools`, and whether a replacement gate exists in the app-server or in the Chat-Completions bridge.

facts.text: Which commit removed `namespace_tools`, and whether a replacement gate exists in the app-server or in the Chat-Completions bridge.
The struct's default sets `image_generation`, `web_search` and `external_web_access` to true and `remote_compaction` to `Unsupported`.
`from_config` sets `remote_compaction` to `V2` for OpenAI and Azure Responses providers and applies config overrides only to `external_web_access` and `remote_compaction`.
The doc comment calls these capabilities "a provider-owned upper bound" that model and turn settings can further restrict.
`ModelProviderCapabilities` has two `Option` fields, `external_web_access` and `remote_compaction`, and denies unknown fields in its JSON schema.
`RemoteCompactionSupport` has two values: `Unsupported` (local compaction) and `V2` (send `compaction_trigger` items over the Responses endpoint).
`ModelProviderInfo` has `capabilities: Option<ModelProviderCapabilities>`, `wire_api`, `supports_websockets` and `supports_standalone_web_search` as separate fields.
The `ModelProvider` trait's default `capabilities()` returns `ProviderCapabilities::default()` and the concrete provider returns `ProviderCapabilities::from_config(&self.info)`.
`ToolSpec::Namespace` is serialized under the tag `namespace` with no provider condition.
`create_tools_json_for_responses_lite` collects `Function`, `Freeform` and default-named namespace specs into one namespace named `DEFAULT_FUNCTION_NAMESPACE` and leaves other specs as they are.

In `client.rs`, `use_responses_lite` selects `create_tools_json_for_responses_lite` and an `AdditionalTools` developer item; other requests use `create_tools_raw_json_for_responses_api`; `parallel_tool_calls` is `prompt.parallel_tool_calls && !model_info.use_responses_lite`.
`spec_plan.rs` passes `model_info.supports_search_tool` to `append_mcp_tools` and merges same-named namespace specs in `merge_into_namespaces`.
The string `namespace_tools` does not appear in `capabilities.rs`, `provider.rs`, `lib.rs` of `codex-model-provider-info`, or `spec_plan.rs` on main.
